subject.title: Theme Customization System — Preset Themes + Custom Theme Studio

question: Should Control UI theming remain Claw/Knot/Dash plus one browser-local tweakcn import slot, or should OpenClaw sponsor a built-in preset gallery and Custom Theme Studio with broader persistence?
rationale: Current source, tests, and docs intentionally expose a narrower one-slot import model, while this issue requests a larger in-product authoring and persistence surface that needs product/design ownership.

options.title: Define a narrow built-in theming roadmap
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, override, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

options.title: Keep tweakcn-only in core
options.body: Document the existing browser-local tweakcn import slot as the supported customization path and close or narrow the larger studio request.

options.title: Split staged theme work
options.body: Track interactive preview, gateway-backed persistence, accessibility presets, and local override editing as separate product-approved slices.

recommendation.title: Define a narrow built-in theming roadmap
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers specify which preset picker, preview, studio, override, accessibility, and persistence pieces belong in core before implementation starts.

likelyOwner.reason: BunsDev is assigned on the issue and authored the current custom theme import path, making them the best available routing owner for the product-direction choice.
